probes.name: r0vm-capabilities
probes.stdout:
RISC Zero zero-knowledge VM executable

Usage: r0vm [OPTIONS] <--rpc|--port <PORT>|--elf <ELF>|--image <IMAGE>|--segment <SEGMENT>|--manager|--worker <WORKER>|--config <CONFIG>>

Options:
      --rpc
          

      --port <PORT>
          

      --elf <ELF>
          The ELF to execute

      --image <IMAGE>
          The image to execute

      --segment <SEGMENT>
          Prove a pre-recorded segment

      --manager
          Start the manager

      --worker <WORKER>
          Start a worker
          
          [possible values: execute, prove-segment, prove-keccak, lift, join, union, resolve]

      --config <CONFIG>
          

      --receipt <RECEIPT>
          Receipt output file

      --hashfn <HASHFN>
          The hash function to use to produce a proof
          
          [default: poseidon2]
          [possible values: sha-256, poseidon2]

      --prove-guest-errors
          Whether to prove executions ending in error status

      --initial-input <INITIAL_INPUT>
          File to read initial input from.
          
          Reads input from stdin if an initial input file is not provided.

  -v, --verbose...
          Display verbose output

      --env <ENV>
          Add environment variables in the form of NAME=value

      --pprof-out <PPROF_OUT>
          Write "pprof" protobuf output of the guest's run to this file. You can use google's pprof (<https://github.com/google/pprof>) to read it
          
          [env: RISC0_PPROF_OUT=]

      --receipt-kind <RECEIPT_KIND>
          The receipt kind produced by the r0vm prover
          
          [default: composite]
          [possible values: composite, succinct, groth16]

      --id
          Compute the image_id for the specified ELF

      --with-debugger
          

      --addr <ADDR>
          The address to connect to or listen on

      --api <API>
          

      --storage <STORAGE>
          

      --po2 <PO2>
          

      --num-gpus <NUM_GPUS>
          Number of GPUs to use

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
